scores.decision_correct_quote: Q1: proceed-with-changes (upgrade to 2.14.5; nats2→nats1→nats3; pin installer; do not treat auth CVEs as the reason). ... Highest-severity: CT 116 and CT 201 both use the `control` superuser on the LIVE desk bus.

must_catch.quote: Highest real risk to the LIVE desk in the captured state is both CT 116 and CT 201 authenticating as `control` (`publish/subscribe allow [">"]`) ... `nats-server.conf.sanitized:29-30` `control` allows `">"`; `rtx`/`arm` exist (`:31-38`) but are unused

Rank next: `support-intake` `max_deliver=-1` (`live-state.md:22`) can duplicate tickets on redelivery; EVENTS `max_bytes=-1` (`live-state.md:21,33`) ... route user tried on client port 4222 (`live-state.md:38`); dead `rtx-serve` (`live-state.md:35`)  ||  do not create streams mid-roll (`live-state.md:39` already did that once on prod)  ||  Investigate route-user misuse and production scratch creation (`live-state.md:38–39`)

Applies: `release-notes-v2.14.5.md:29` “data loss when … an offline node catches up from a metalayer snapshot”; `v2.14.4.md:56` “Raft elections now correctly ignore votes from removed peers”; ... `v2.14.3.md:85` “Meta recovery snapshots no longer leave phantom streams”. Does not apply: `v2.14.4.md:39` TLS `verify_and_map` ... MQTT ... JWT claims ... leaf `Nats-Trace-Dest`  ||  queue-permission fixes are conditional, whereas JetStream null-JSON and monitoring-input guards remain relevant (`release-notes-v2.14.4.md:37–39`)

Roll followers first, meta leader last: nats2 → nats1 → nats3 ... `live-state.md:7-8,13-21,28` nats3 is seed + meta leader + JOBS leader; nats1 leads RESULTS+EVENTS (desk stream) and holds 3/4 client conns; nats2 leads nothing

`systemctl is-active` is not “back and current”; gate the next node from a **surviving** `:8222` ... (4) survivor `/jsz` has a meta leader and JOBS/RESULTS/EVENTS each have a `leader` ... (5) `GET /jsz?raft=true` on a survivor — if present, every replica `current` and `pending==0` ... (7) `connz?auth=true` shows the clients that were on that node

Pin the installer to `v2.14.5`; do not run `install-nats.sh` as written ... `install-nats.sh:6-10` `releases/latest` → `install -m755 … /usr/local/bin/nats-server` with no pin; `live-state.md:10` “no documented rollback path” ... rollback is saved 2.14.2 binary plus the pre-node `js` tarball

A2 requires proving ticket idempotency and client recovery before disruption, because redelivery cannot be assumed harmless ... Client implementation is unavailable: harmlessness is **SPECULATIVE**. Proposed discriminating test: interrupt after ticket creation but before acknowledgment ... require exactly one ticket per source ID
`nats-store-monitor.sh:2-9` checks only store bytes  ||  Monitoring needs correction before rollout because its missing-field default can report zero usage.
